production_plan.notes: One production job is a base/overlay configuration at a length category with an explicit seed and categorical sampling policy. Realizations are shared across recipes, not multiplied by recipe count.

target_release.note: User-selected total. Equal allocation across three lengths is a v2 choice; not a recovered historical manifest.

paper_alignment.claims: Taxonomy and representative compound coverage; not an exact historical configuration or parameter reproduction.

seasonal_override_rationale: Explicit dataset-specific short periods preserve 50-100 observations and the existing six-cycle minimum. Medium/long and the published BeTiSe package are unchanged.
validation_scope: Runnable reproduction recipe: structural, declared metadata and categorical-count checks passed; not a claim of reproduced paper results or empirical stationarity certification.
